params.prompt:
Title: Nice to Meet You on the Desert Oasis Path

Duration: 15 seconds

Format: 16:9 horizontal

Cinematic Style: Hand-painted watercolor and gouache storybook animation matching the Magic English Voyage desert map. Warm cream daylight, sand and clay tones, pale mint-green oasis plants, tiny coral accents, soft pencil outlines, paper grain, low saturation, brush texture. Child-safe attractive faces: bright clean eyes, soft cheeks, balanced proportions. Not glossy 3D, not plastic CGI, not neon, not hard vector.

Source Situation: Two young children meet for the first time on a desert-oasis path. They are not together at the start. Child A comes from the left path; Child B comes from the right path. They pause with shy smiles, then immediately use an empty-handed gentle handshake while saying "Nice to meet you." The meaning must read as first-time meeting, not just a casual hello greeting. No classroom, no flashcards, no written labels.

CEFR Target: Pre-A1 / very young A1. The target English expression is "Nice to meet you". The learner may know zero English. Keep every line short and natural. "Nice to meet you" must sound like a real first-meeting sentence, not a vocabulary drill.

Zero-beginner clarity rule: Whenever "Nice to meet you" is spoken, the image must already teach the meaning. The speaking child's face and mouth must be visible to the camera.
